t: Buying A House In California In 7 Steps | Bankrate
s: July 25, 2025 - The median down payment on a new home in California was $164,000 in the spring of 2025, according to figures from ATTOM. That’s a staggeringly high sum if you’re on a tight budget, but you probably don’t need that much cash to buy a place here. With a conventional loan, you’ll need a minimum down payment of 3 percent of the purchase price.

t: How to Buy a Home in California | City National Bank
s: Meeting with a local lender and getting a loan approval based on full documentation of your income, assets, job history and credit report can give you – and the home sellers – the confidence that your transaction will be successfully completed. Keep in mind that when you buy a house in California lenders approve you based on a set of guidelines including the size of your down payment, your credit history and your debt-to-income ratio, which compares your monthly income to your minimum payment on recurring debt.
